description.en-US: Saved memories stay on this desktop. Changes apply after restarting the backend.
description.zh-CN: 已保存的记忆留在本机。设置在后端重启后生效。

description.en-US: Let the character recall saved or formed memories. A cloud character receives the permitted evidence needed for the reply.
description.zh-CN: 允许角色查阅此前手动保存和自动形成的记忆。使用云端角色时，获准用于回答的依据会交给该角色的服务商。

description.en-US: Use your DeepSeek API key to send eligible new messages, speaker roles, and record times to DeepSeek Flash at api.deepseek.com in the background. Review suggestions in the Memory panel.
description.zh-CN: 使用你的 DeepSeek API 密钥，在后台将获准的新消息、说话者角色和记录时间交给 api.deepseek.com 的 DeepSeek Flash。可在记忆面板审阅建议。
